status.description: Resulting status of the processed piece record

error.description: Error details in case claiming process for the piece record has failed

deliveryType.description: How the claim reaches the vendor: MANUAL = outside FOLIO (no export job, the user contacts the vendor), INTEGRATION = through a Claims integration. INTEGRATION for pieces claimed without claim sequence

transmissionMethod.description: Transmission method of the applied claim sequence stage; absent for MANUAL stages and pieces claimed without claim sequence

claimSequenceId.description: UUID of the claim sequence the piece was claimed by; absent for pieces claimed without claim sequence

stage.description: Position of the applied claim sequence stage (1, 2, 3, ...); absent for pieces claimed without claim sequence

stageName.description: Name of the applied claim sequence stage; absent for pieces claimed without claim sequence

claimingInterval.description: Claiming interval (in days) written to the piece: the stage interval for claim sequence pieces, otherwise the interval of the request
